label: D1 after a rewarded trial (sparse subset; mid-high value, early-mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded): this condition covers 99.6% of activations and ~100% of activation mass, but the feature fires on just ~1.7% of such steps, so precision is very low. Never fires at GO or D2, nor after unrewarded trials. Which rewarded D1 steps fire is not explained by observed task history: lifts for previous rare transition (2.4x), a2-choice, and good=S2 are modest. It is enriched early-mid episode (absent after trial ~85) and concentrated where the model value output is in [7.73, 8.10) and the policy logit difference is near 0 (-1.5..2.8); restricting to that value band gives dev F1 0.37 (precision 0.26, mass recall 0.74), but that is a model-internal readout, not an input. Higher-activation steps are more reliably in that value band. Recorded the simple observed predicate (necessary condition), and the verdict reflects the large unexplained precision gap.
